name: Local-First, Offline-Capable Edge AI & Desktop Stack
category: Local-First Architecture, Edge Computing & Desktop AI
target_audience: Desktop Developers, Privacy-First AI Engineers, Embedded & Edge Specialists
summary: Privacy-first, zero-cloud dependency edge architecture combining GGUF quantized local LLM inference, embedded SQLite/DuckDB relational and vector storage, and a memory-efficient Rust-powered Tauri UI shell.
architecture_overview: Cloud LLMs introduce latency, recurring API costs, and data privacy liabilities. The Local-First & Edge AI Stack flips this model by executing models directly on end-user hardware (Apple Silicon Metal, NVIDIA CUDA, or modern x86/ARM CPUs). llama.cpp and Ollama manage quantized GGUF models; LibSQL / Turso and DuckDB provide zero-latency embedded databases; and Tauri wraps the web interface in a tiny 15MB native binary with ~30MB RAM usage compared to Electron's 200MB+ footprint.

tiers.name: Edge LLM Inference & Model Management Engine
tiers.purpose: High-speed local quantized model loading, token generation, and hardware acceleration.

primary_component.role: Plain C/C++ LLM inference engine with zero external dependencies and AVX/NEON/Metal/CUDA kernels
primary_component.why_chosen: Gold standard for edge efficiency; supports 2-bit to 8-bit GGUF quantization with minimal memory overhead.
primary_component.trade_offs: Lower-level C++ CLI/API requiring wrapper bindings for high-level language integration.

alternative_components.role: Developer-friendly local LLM daemon with REST API and modelfile packaging
alternative_components.trade_offs: Slightly higher daemon memory baseline than bare llama.cpp library.

alternative_components.role: Official lightweight Python SDK for Ollama API interaction
alternative_components.trade_offs: Depends on running Ollama service in background.

tiers.name: Embedded Local Database & Analytics Storage
tiers.purpose: Store relational records, local chat history, offline sync queues, and fast analytical OLAP queries.

primary_component.role: Fork of SQLite optimized for local-first embedded operation, vector search, and edge replication
primary_component.why_chosen: Maintains 100% SQLite compatibility while adding vector extensions and bidirectional cloud sync capabilities.
primary_component.trade_offs: Newer ecosystem than upstream 24-year-old vanilla SQLite.

alternative_components.role: In-process analytical SQL database engine with columnar vector execution
alternative_components.trade_offs: Optimized for heavy analytical read queries rather than rapid high-frequency OLTP key-value writes.

alternative_components.role: Classic public-domain in-process transactional SQL engine
alternative_components.trade_offs: No built-in native remote sync replication.

tiers.name: Lightweight Native Shell & Web UI
tiers.purpose: Deliver a native desktop experience with native OS tray, menu bar, and minimal memory footprint.

primary_component.role: Rust-based framework for building tiny, blazing fast native applications with web frontends
primary_component.why_chosen: Uses system webview (WebKit/WebView2); binary size under 15MB with <40MB idle RAM usage.
primary_component.trade_offs: Requires Rust toolchain during development; platform-specific webview rendering differences.

alternative_components.role: Feature-rich extensible, self-hosted AI interface for Ollama
alternative_components.trade_offs: Full web server architecture rather than compiled standalone desktop client.

end_to_end_workflow: User Keystroke -> Tauri Native Shell IPC -> Embedded LibSQL Local State Query -> llama.cpp Metal/CUDA Quantized Generation -> Streaming UI Token Update (100% Offline)

data_flow_stages.title: Local Storage & Session Retrieval
data_flow_stages.input: User workspace switch or document selection
data_flow_stages.output: Instant relational state load from in-process SQLite/libSQL file (<1ms)
data_flow_stages.verification: Zero network requests dispatched; zero-alloc memory mapped I/O.

data_flow_stages.title: On-Device Quantized Model Execution
data_flow_stages.input: Context prompt and token generation hyperparameters
data_flow_stages.output: Token stream generated at 45-80 tokens/sec on modern laptop silicon
data_flow_stages.verification: Monitor VRAM allocation to ensure model fits within unified memory budget.

data_flow_stages.title: Native UI Rendering & IPC Response
data_flow_stages.input: Generated token chunks over Tauri IPC Rust channel
data_flow_stages.output: 60fps smooth Markdown streaming render in lightweight webview
data_flow_stages.verification: Confirm overall application memory footprint remains under 120MB RSS during generation.

production_readiness.sla_target: 100% offline availability; zero data exfiltration; instantaneous application startup (<250ms)
security_considerations: Zero telemetry leakage or outbound external phone-home connections
Full-disk encryption / SQLCipher database encryption for sensitive local chats
Strict Tauri IPC command allowlists preventing arbitrary OS process spawning

failure_modes_and_mitigations.failure_mode: Out-of-memory crash when loading oversized LLM weights
failure_modes_and_mitigations.mitigation: Detect host physical RAM on startup and clamp maximum model parameter count to Q4_K_M quant.

failure_modes_and_mitigations.failure_mode: Slow token generation on legacy CPU without AVX-512
failure_modes_and_mitigations.mitigation: Fallback to smaller 1B/3B distilled models (Llama 3.2 1B or Qwen 2.5 1.5B).
